supersedes: modern/spec/pic2d/pic2d-model-v1.4.json (all v1.4 physics, gates, time step, checkpoint and artifact contracts are kept and apply over the whole domain; this file adds the optional plume block: L-shaped domain, internal channel walls, far-field boundary, cathode emission region, two-zone neutrals, momentum/thrust ledgers, plume diagnostics and the plume-boundary gate; a channel-only configuration is bit-identical to v1.4)
source_of_the_changes: modern/docs/literature/pic-mcc-blockers.md: blocker 4d (section 4.4 exit-plane / cathode boundary: Szabo 2001; Charoy et al. 2019; Boeuf and Garrigues 2018; Brandt et al. 2016; Duras et al. 2017; Matyash et al. 2010), blocker 3 (neutrals: Szabo 2001/2014; Brandt et al. 2016), 4.1 (ion-neutral: Miller et al. 2002 - deferred), blocker 6 (validation observables: Koch et al. IEPC-2011-236; Keller et al. 2015; Brandt et al. 2016)
what_changed: domain: optional plume box appended to the channel; the channel walls, the divergent cone and the exit lip become internal masked boundaries; the thruster front face is split into a dielectric flange and a grounded conductor; the far-field box boundary is Dirichlet at the reference potential
cathode: electron emission region (annulus in the plume) with fixed-current or current-continuity rule replaces the exit-plane injection (kept as the legacy option)
neutrals: two-zone closure - channel 0-D inventory (v1.4 with recycling; front-face ions not recycled) + analytic free-molecular cone in the plume as the local MCC factor

diagnostics: axial momentum ledger per interval (round-off closure), momentum-flux thrust per species + cold gas, momentum-balance thrust, Maxwell-stress force on every solid boundary, closure fraction; far-field histograms j_i(theta) and IEDF; exit-plane potential and acceleration region; Isp and anode efficiency

gates: peak-node Debye gate and grid-heating triad over the whole domain; plume-boundary charge pile-up gate (fail-closed); Poisson manufactured-solution and second-order truncation tests on the L-shaped mesh; force-balance (Newton's third law) test
field: direct P2 node evaluation over the plume box (spec/pic2d/p2-field-plume-extension-v1.json); the channel authority and all v1.x field identities are untouched

geometry_keys.plume_radius_m: R_plume: outer radius of the box (far-field cylinder r = R_plume for z >= L_channel)
geometry_keys.body_dielectric_radius_m: r_body: the front face z = L_channel is dielectric (surface charge) for r_exit < r <= r_body and a grounded conductor for r > r_body

domain_v2_0.grid_rules: uniform (dr, dz) over the whole box (no graded spacing in the solver); the exit plane, the lip radius and r_body must lie on grid lines (Grid2D validation)
domain_v2_0.plasma_region: L-shaped: channel cells r < r_wall(z) for z < L_channel (one-cell stair-step cone) plus every cell of the plume box

boundaries.anode: z = 0, r < r_bore: Dirichlet U_a (absorbing conductor)
boundaries.channel_wall_and_cone: internal dielectric: masked solid nodes, plasma-side boundary nodes carry the accumulated surface charge; zero field inside (homogeneous Neumann, v1.x closure)
boundaries.front_face_dielectric: z = L_channel, r_exit < r <= r_body: internal dielectric ring with surface charge (the BN flange and, in divergent-exit-stack, the 4.0-4.4 mm gap in front of the pole stack closed as dielectric)
boundaries.front_face_conductor: z = L_channel, r > r_body: Dirichlet at the reference potential (exit_v). DECLARED grounded conductor: the soft-iron pole faces / shield of a HEMP-T are metal on the cathode/chamber reference (Kornfeld, Koch and Harmann 2007; Koch et al. 2011); a floating face would need a charge-balance closure with its own time scale
boundaries.far_field: r = R_plume (z >= L_channel) and z = z_max: Dirichlet exit_v (0 V chamber / neutraliser reference), the literature's practice (Brandt et al. 2016: 0 V Dirichlet on the outer boundaries; Matyash et al. 2010); switching to Neumann changed Brandt's plume current ratios, so the choice is declared and the pile-up gate checks it

domain_v2_0.particle_boundary_classes: anode, wall (channel dielectric incl. cone), body_face (front-face dielectric and conductor, tallied per species), exit (= far field in the plume geometry; the beam), invalid (Courant violation)
domain_v2_0.development_size: divergent-exit-stack: R_plume = 12 mm (4 r_exit, 6 r_bore; the return-yoke radius), L_plume = 12 mm (0.5 L_channel, BOUNDED by the P2 FEM domain z <= 36.25 mm - the 1-1.5 L_channel first size is deferred to a new FEM solve), uniform 50 um: 240 x 720 cells, 77,940 plasma cells, 78,228 unknowns; Brandt et al. 2016 comparison: 20 x 5 mm box behind a 14 x 1.5 mm channel (1.4 L x 3.3 r) 'still too small' for plume ratios
domain_v2_0.cost: measured 2026-09-03 (RTX 5090, CUDA-graph step): field map 6 s; host Schur factorisation of 241 axial-row blocks (721 x 721) ~5 min per launch, 1.0 GB on device; 4.2 ms/step at 0.55 M particles (direct-solve floor ~3 ms from 482 sequential row-block matvecs); projected 5-7 ms/step at 4-6 M particles

cathode_v2_0.class: CathodeConfig(r_inner_m, r_outer_m, z_start_m, z_end_m, electron_temperature_ev, current_a, current_rule, max_current_a, continuity_relaxation_intervals)
cathode_v2_0.emission: electrons born uniformly in the annulus volume (r^2-uniform, z-uniform) with an isotropic Maxwellian at electron_temperature_ev (the v1.x 2 eV); the Poisson step sees them at the next deposit; born momentum tallied (pz_injected)
cathode_v2_0.position: INSIDE the channel's exit flux tube in the plume (development run attempt 4: r 0.5-2.0 mm, z = L_channel + 0.3-1.0 mm). The first placement - an off-axis annulus in front of the pole face (attempt 3: r 4.5-6.0 mm = 1.5-2 r_exit, z = L_channel + 2-4 mm, the HEMP-T neutraliser position of Kornfeld, Koch and Harmann 2007 / Koch et al. 2011) - did not ignite: event-aware field-line tracing (cft_revival.pic2d.fieldlines, RK2 on the bilinear node field, terminations channel / anode / wall / body / far_field / axis / null) showed the channel's flux tube closes on the front face within ~1.5 mm of the exit (axis null at z = 25.45 mm) and that the annulus sat on pole-face-to-far-field lines (connected fraction 0/24); 95 % of the emitted current left through the far field, I_d -> 0, S fell x15 in 1.1 us. In an electrostatic model without anomalous transport and with a near-collisionless plume, electrons do not cross between flux tubes, so the emission region must lie on lines that enter the bore; it represents the arrival of the neutraliser electrons into the channel-connected tube (the real device crosses the weak-field region by collisions/instabilities the model excludes; Brandt et al. 2016 fed electrons from the far outer boundary at 1 eV in a model with Bohm transport). Declared, fail-closed: cathode.require_channel_connected_fraction (the runner re-traces the region at launch and records the result in summary.json cathode_connectivity)
cathode_v2_0.ignition_gate: stopping_rule.ignition_gate: trailing-window means of S and N_e at declared check times over their reference means after the seed dump (0.05-0.2 us); stop_reason no_ignition (fail-closed) when a check fails; calibrated on v1.3 attempts 1 (failed) / 2 (ignited) and plume attempt 3 - see the protocol note; the contingency if attempt 4 still fails is a declared ignition sequence (exit-plane injection inside the channel for the first N us ramped to zero while the plume cathode carries the current; switch time recorded and excluded from the plateau window), NOT implemented yet

rules.fixed: current_a every step (the v1.x fixed-current rule moved into the plume)
rules.continuity: the emitted current follows the previous series interval's discharge current I_d = e (anode electrons - anode ions)/interval, relaxed by an exponential moving average over continuity_relaxation_intervals intervals and clamped to [current_a (floor = ignition current), max_current_a]; charge conservation of the plasma gives I_cathode = I_d + (I_e - I_i)_far, so in steady state the far-field boundary carries no net current to the chamber. Review section 4.4 variant (c) (Szabo 2001 'injected at a rate which preserved quasineutrality'; Charoy et al. 2019 / Boeuf and Garrigues 2018 cathode-plane injection tied to the current leaving)

cathode_v2_0.legacy: InjectionConfig (exit-plane flux-weighted half-Maxwellian at fixed current) is kept for A/B; a config may carry a cathode or an injection, not both; the cathode requires a plume geometry
cathode_v2_0.recorded: currents_a.cathode_emission_a; momentum.cathode_target_rate_per_step / cathode_rate_per_step / cathode_emission_next_a / cathode_clamped; the live rate is checkpointed in cumulative[cathode_rate_per_step]

neutrals_v2_0.channel_zone: v1.4 0-D inventory over the CHANNEL plasma cells only (volume = channel_volume_m3): feed, exit-aperture effusion, ionisation (channel + plume ionisations both consume channel atoms: the plume atoms are the effused channel atoms), wall/anode ion recycling; ions absorbed on the front face are NOT recycled into the channel (they recombine outside)
neutrals_v2_0.plume_zone: n_g(r,z) = n_g,channel x f(r,z) with f the cosine-law point-source expansion of the channel's effusion flux Phi = n_g v_bar A_exit / 4 from the aperture centre: flux density Phi cos(theta) / (pi rho^2) at distance rho and polar angle theta, divided by the mean speed 3 pi v_bar / 8 of the effusing atoms, gives f = 2 A_exit cos(theta) / (3 pi^2 rho^2), capped at 0.5 (the outgoing half-Maxwellian at the aperture); f = 1 in the channel (free-molecular effusion through an orifice: Bird 1994). Used ONLY as the per-particle MCC probability factor (density_shape) in the null-collision scheme; the plume atoms are not an inventory of their own
neutrals_v2_0.null_collision_ceiling: the MCC null-collision ceiling carries declared headroom above the zero-ionisation density Q/c and the inventory starts at the declared initial_density_per_m3 (= Q/c): with recycling and the artificial relaxation, n_g tracks the rate-based fixed point (Q + R - S)/c, which exceeds Q/c while a seeded ion population drains (R > S) - the plume development run's first launch stopped fail-closed on this at 14 ns with the ceiling AT Q/c. In steady state R <= S bounds n* <= Q/c; the transient is an artefact of the development relaxation and is recorded (max n_g / (Q/c)). The real collision rate is unchanged (probability scale n_g / ceiling); the null-collision cost grows with the headroom (2x: 1.3e-4 per step)
neutrals_v2_0.relaxation_suspension: the artificial relaxation toward n* = (Q + R - S)/c is defined only while a fixed point exists; in any interval with S > Q + R (n* < 0) it is suspended and the inventory follows the conservative balance dn/dt = (Q + R - S - c n)/V alone (NeutralAdvance.artificial_relaxation_suspended; a guard, the v1.3/v1.4 channel runs never reached S > Q + R so their closure is bit-identical). tests/pic2d/test_pic2d_neutral_inventory.py::test_v20_artificial_relaxation_is_suspended_when_ionisation_exceeds_the_sources
neutrals_v2_0.graph_safe_mcc_density: DEFECT FIXED 2026-09-04 (plume attempts 4-5): the v1.4 CUDA-graph step passed the instantaneous MCC neutral density n_g0 x scale as a kernel scalar, which a captured graph freezes at capture time; the MCC therefore ionised at the n_g of the last capture (a particle-array reallocation) rather than the inventory's n_g. Attempt 4: the connected cathode ignited the channel (S 1.4e16 -> 7.3e16 /s in 0.39 us, the continuity cathode following I_d to 7 mA) with S unchecked by the falling inventory until S = 1.26 Q, the relaxation toward the negative fixed point emptied the channel in one 30 ns interval (5.5e19 -> 4.2e18), and the MCC then kept the trough density (S/(n_e n_g) x100 low at an unchanged T_e distribution) so the discharge did not recover when n_g refilled; the ignition gate stopped it at 0.75 us. The density is now a one-element device array read by mcc_kernel (warp_backend.set_neutral_scale copies into it), as the emission rate already was; the direct and graph paths are bitwise while n_g changes every interval (tests/pic2d/test_pic2d_neutral_inventory.py::test_cuda_graph_step_sees_every_neutral_density_update, which fails on the old backend). Affected runs: plume attempts 3-5 only (attempt 3's n_g stayed within 5.6-6.3e19; its cathode-coupling diagnosis stands). Unaffected: every v1.3 record (steady-state v2 base, seed-b, W x 0.7 - launched before the graph commit 112bb250) and the CPU/host-launch paths
neutrals_v2_0.ion_neutral: OFF (no CEX / elastic Xe+-Xe): the Miller et al. 2002 hash-bound table is the declared next sensitivity flag (review 4.1); the plume IEDF and j_i(theta) are therefore collisionless-ion development numbers (Duras et al. 2017: CEX shapes the far plume distributions)
neutrals_v2_0.recorded: neutral.* as v1.4; currents_a.plume_ionization_rate_per_s; cumulative ionizations_plume

thrust_and_plume_diagnostics_v2_0.momentum_ledger: per series interval, axial: dP = impulse(E, B) + collisions + born + injected - exit - wall - anode (macro-weighted, both species); residual is round-off (tests); keys MOMENTUM_KEYS in cumulative
thrust_and_plume_diagnostics_v2_0.thrust_momentum_flux: T_flux = sum over far-field crossings of m v_z W / dt per species minus the momentum brought in by the cathode; T_total = T_flux + cold gas, cold gas = Phi_effusion m (pi/4) v_bar (half-Maxwellian momentum flux through the aperture)
thrust_and_plume_diagnostics_v2_0.thrust_momentum_balance: -F_on_thruster with F_on_thruster = (momentum deposited on the anode, wall and front face) - (field impulse on the plasma: E and B, the magnets are part of the thruster); closure = (T_flux - (-F_on_thruster)) normalised; the non-closing terms (stored momentum rate, collision momentum handed to the neutrals, far-field electrostatic force, born momentum) are reported
thrust_and_plume_diagnostics_v2_0.electrostatic_force: independent field-side check: Maxwell stress T.n integrated over the plasma-side faces of the plasma cell mask touching each solid (anode, dielectric incl. the tangential-field pressure on the cone steps and the front-face ring, front-face conductor, far field); Newton's third law F_plasma + F_thruster + F_far = 0 holds to the first-order discretisation error of the one-sided boundary fields (test: 28 % -> 5.8 % -> 2.5 % at 0.25 / 0.125 / 0.0625 mm)
thrust_and_plume_diagnostics_v2_0.far_field_histograms: ion current per steradian about the aperture centre j_i(theta), 90 bins over 0-90 deg; IEDF 256 bins to 1.5 U_a; side (cylinder) and plane current densities per species; all window accumulations
thrust_and_plume_diagnostics_v2_0.derived: 95 % divergence half-angle from the theta histogram; IEDF mean and peak, peak - U_a (Koch et al. IEPC-2011-236: ion-energy peak ~ U_a - 15 V for the HEMP-T 3050 - the validation-v1 observable, reported as context, not validated at this closure); exit-plane axis potential (self-consistent); acceleration region = z where the axis potential has dropped 90 % and 10 % of the way from its maximum to the far plane; Isp = T_total / (m_dot g0); anode efficiency = T_total^2 / (2 m_dot U_a I_d)
thrust_and_plume_diagnostics_v2_0.claim_boundary: development numbers bound to the box size and the closure (Dirichlet far field, no CEX, volumetric cathode); Brandt et al. 2016 and Keller et al. 2015 (thrust 50-360 uN, Isp 230-860 s for the downscaled HEMPT family) are model-to-model / different-device context, never validation

gates_v2_0.inherited: peak-node Debye gate, grid-heating triad, omega_pe dt, Courant, Poisson residual contract, neutral inventory bounds - evaluated over the whole L-shaped domain
gates_v2_0.plume_boundary_gate: PlumeBoundaryGateConfig(max_charge_fraction, enforce_after_s): at every series record the net charge density on the far-field nodes (from the last deposit) must stay below max_charge_fraction of the peak electron density; a violation after enforce_after_s stops the run fail-closed (PIC2DStabilityError 'plume-boundary gate'); the far-field potential deviation from exit_v is recorded (Dirichlet: exactly 0). Rationale: a sheath on the box boundary means the box is too small for the beam to leave quasi-neutrally (Brandt et al. 2016)
gates_v2_0.tests: tests/pic2d/test_pic2d_v20_plume.py (19): geometry contract, grid-line rules, L-shaped masks, particle boundary classification incl. internal walls, Poisson manufactured solution (round-off, direct and PCG) and second-order truncation of the discrete operator on the L-shaped mesh, cosine-cone neutral shape and MCC density factor, cathode sampling / fixed / continuity rules, momentum ledger round-off closure with fields and boundaries, force balance (Newton's third law), momentum-flux thrust on a synthetic beam, plume gate fail-closed, plume record, channel-only seed, two-zone inventory; tests/pic2d/test_pic2d_warp_parity.py: tiny L-shaped CPU/GPU parity (bitwise masks, exits, phi, histograms, ledgers; cathode samples distributional); tests/pic2d/test_pic2d_steady_state_runner.py: plume protocol build, run, resume, artifacts

frame_recorder_v2_0.purpose: time-series video of the whole run (maps evolving), not only the window-averaged final maps; a diagnostics artefact with no effect on the dynamics (nothing added to the step kernels)
frame_recorder_v2_0.config: numerics.frame_recorder = {cadence_steps, precision} in the protocol (absent = OFF, the v1.x behaviour); the plume development run declares cadence 20000 steps = 30 ns at dt 1.5 ps, float32
frame_recorder_v2_0.content: per frame, over the FULL domain: exact interval averages of n_e, n_i, phi, T_e (from the accumulated moments, drift-corrected), ionisation rate and the electron sample counts (node maps); wall electron/ion flux, exit and side (far-field) current-density profiles, j_i(theta) and the IEDF of the interval; the instantaneous dielectric surface charge at the frame end; the scalar series record at the frame end (t, I_d, I_beam, S, N_e, N_i, n_g, thrust flux/balance/total, closure, cathode current, mean T_e)
frame_recorder_v2_0.method: the window accumulators are additive sums reset at window boundaries; a frame is the difference of two cumulative snapshots divided through by DiagnosticAccumulator.to_arrays, so it is the exact average over (a, b] with T_e from the interval's own moments (differencing the finished maps could not give T_e). Alignment contract, fail-closed at start: cadence is a multiple of device_sync_steps and divides checkpoint_every_steps and averaging_window_steps, so every checkpoint and window reset is a frame boundary
frame_recorder_v2_0.storage: frames/frame-NNNNNN.npz, one compressed file per frame written atomically (temp + replace) BEFORE the checkpoint that follows it; on resume/finalize the frames ending after the checkpoint step are removed (a crash between a frame and its checkpoint cannot duplicate or drop a frame); the manifest (count, bytes, step range, SHA-256 over the sorted per-file digests, config) is hash-bound in summary.json artifacts.frames; bitwise deterministic for the same run (test: byte-identical frames from a fresh run; frames of the first session untouched by the resume)
frame_recorder_v2_0.size: 241 x 721 nodes x float32 x 7 arrays = 4.9 MB/frame uncompressed (measured 7:1 zip on the tiny fixture; expect 2-4:1 on the real grid); 100-140 frames in the 4 h budget = 0.5-0.7 GB, 257 frames (7.7 us) = 1.26 GB uncompressed: inside the 1-2 GB envelope with no spatial downsampling; the HTML player downsamples 2x (block mean, counts summed) itself
frame_recorder_v2_0.renderer: modern/visualization/render_pic2d_video.py: (a) one MP4 per map (H.264 yuv420p, CRF 18) through imageio_ffmpeg if importable (installed in .venv-sota only), else the ffmpeg executable on PATH (raw RGB pipe), else an animated GIF through Pillow - the backend used is reported; frames carry the map (nearest upscale), the plasma-mask outline (thruster body), cusp planes, a fixed colour bar and a synchronised strip of I_d / I_beam / N_e / n_g / T with a cursor; (b) pic2d-<run>-timeseries.html: offline player with the frames embedded as 2x-downsampled palette PNGs (float32 -> 254 colour indices + body + mask), scrubber / play / speed / map selector / keyboard arrows, body outline and cusp planes drawn, synchronised time series under the map, hash-bound to the frames manifest and the protocol
frame_recorder_v2_0.colour_scale: fixed across ALL frames so the eye sees evolution, not autoscaling: log10 with a floor of max/10^4 for n_e, n_i and the ionisation rate (maximum over the unmasked plasma nodes of all frames); full range for phi (diverging palette); 0 to the 99.5th percentile for T_e; cells with fewer than N = 20 electron samples in the interval are grey (the sampling mask of the dashboards), non-plasma nodes dark
frame_recorder_v2_0.tests: tests/pic2d/test_pic2d_frames.py (3): config/alignment contract and the real protocol's size envelope; exact interval algebra on a synthetic accumulator (maps, fluxes, histograms to 1e-9, T_e to 1e-6); runner cadence/shapes/scalars, window-mean consistency, manifest, stray-frame removal on resume, contiguity, first-session frames untouched, byte-identical fresh run, OFF by default. tests/pic2d/test_pic2d_video_renderer.py (4): palette mapping (lo/mid/hi, zero/NaN on log, sample mask, body precedence, clipping), fixed scales (mask-aware maximum), block downsampling, outline, GIF/MP4 writers, deterministic render_run on a tiny run with a validated hash-bound payload and CLI

unchanged_from_v1_4: time step, Boris push, ion subcycling, fixed-point deposition, bilinear gather, null-collision MCC (Vahedi-Surendra), dielectric surface-charge closure, wall-ion recycling, artificial relaxation option, peak-node Debye gate, grid-heating triad, CUDA-graph step, sensitivity hooks (Bohm alpha, SEE scaffold, both OFF), checkpoint and artifact contracts
remaining_simplifications: plume box 0.5 L_channel long (FEM-bounded); Dirichlet far field; box-size dependent plume ratios
no CEX / ion-neutral collisions; plume neutrals are an analytic shape, not an inventory
volumetric cathode without cathode physics or neutral flow
grounded front face beyond r_body (declared); dielectric flange with the v1.x perfect-insulator closure
no SEE emission, no anomalous transport, prescribed static B, electrostatic axisymmetric
uniform grid: the channel radial spacing coarsens to the plume spacing (50 um in the development run)
